name: libxsmm-n512-tb-with-timed-sme-a-transpose
hypothesis: Implement the selected TRANS_B descriptor and physical A transpose using the supplied sme_transpose and sera_libxsmm_tb. The conversion writes at[k*512+i]=A[i*512+k] into a fresh 1 MiB FP32 buffer. Slots [4]=B, [10]=at and [16]=C preserve row-major C=A@B. Correction to the recommendation: the supplied TB path skips generated B-stack packing and does not add A-stack packing. This tests whether the complete changed path offsets allocation, conversion, cleanup and different memory access costs; the net performance effect is unknown. Other sizes retain the existing general fallback; allocation failure calls unchanged full512 NN. All assembly and complete BSD notices remain unchanged. This descriptor-and-layout change is absent from the supplied measured history and differs from the prior C SME compute path. No tools or tests were run. Compilation, fresh-input correctness, full overwrite, tolerance 0.002, tails, n<=0 and allocation-failure checks remain required. Measure ten validation reports and ten fresh alternating paired controls on unchanged AC Automatic, preserving best-of-three timing. Report spread and comparisons against historical AC peak 1685.6230608449698 and fresh same-mode peak; retain Battery Automatic history separately. Adoption requires min(candidate)>1.05*max(paired controls) and the unchanged held-out check. No gain, causal effect or goal completion is established.
